hooks.command:
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || { printf "%s
" "Repository hook: start the session in the trusted checkout containing .agents/hooks." >&2; exit 2; }; f="$root/.agents/hooks/pre-tool-use.mjs"; [ -f "$f" ] || { printf "%s
" "Repository hook: shared entry point is missing at $f; repair this checkout before retrying." >&2; exit 2; }; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf "%s
" "Repository hook: Node is missing from PATH; install the repository runtime." >&2; exit 2; }; node "$f" codex || { printf "%s
" "Repository hook: Node policy check failed; repair the runtime or shared hooks before retrying." >&2; exit 2; }
hooks.commandWindows: $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"; try { $hookRoot = git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Start the session in the trusted checkout containing .agents/hooks." }; $hookFile = "$hookRoot/.agents/hooks/pre-tool-use.mjs"; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $hookFile -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Shared entry point is missing at $hookFile; repair this checkout before retrying." }; & node "$hookFile" codex; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Node policy check failed; repair the runtime or shared hooks before retrying." } } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("Repository hook: " + $_.Exception.Message); exit 2 }
